task_title: Discover local weapon sweeps in canvas

plan_review.notes: Alternatives: manifest-driven catalog rejected because atomic index maintenance adds a second failure mode; sidecar provenance rejected because it splits one result identity across files; unified cloud/local descriptors rejected because source-specific polling and local file errors remain materially different. Adopted refinements: explicit gitignore, Windows-safe UTC names with exclusive suffixes, one local parser, strict present-floor validation, separate selectedLocalPath invariant, runAt ordering, and legacy provenance warning.
